title: The Garden of Caerlum Again
author: Gideon Okafor
blurb: Orsen Halloran, a thief who steals memories, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
